capabilities: expand LaTeX code from text and regex snippets while typing
auto-expand fractions from slash input and enlarge enclosing brackets
conceal LaTeX markup to display rendered symbols
navigate and exit equations and matrix environments with Tab and Enter
surround selected math with underbrace, cancel, or highlight snippets
extras: The README warns that snippet files are JavaScript and can execute arbitrary code, so shared snippets should be treated carefully. Conceal requires a font that supports the displayed symbols (JuliaMono is suggested); deeper snippet-writing documentation is hosted externally.
intentEvidence: Inspired by Gilles Castel's setup using UltiSnips.
motivation: The README says the plugin is inspired by Gilles Castel's LaTeX setup using UltiSnips, bringing that snippet workflow into Obsidian.
problem: Typing LaTeX math markup by hand is slow and repetitive, and Obsidian has no built-in text expansion or math-specific editor aids.

relations.evidence: @tth05's Obsidian Completr for the basis of the tabstop code.
